rows.title: The germinal products origin page's Back link returns to wherever the notification was started from
rows.detail: A trader reaches the germinal products set's 'Origin of the import' page three ways: by choosing germinal products on the question that asks what they are importing, by creating a notification from the germinal products set's own notifications list, and by opening the origin task from a notification's overview. Back should take them to whichever of those they came from, so leaving the page never drops them into another set's pages or onto a list they never visited. The live animals set already works this way; the germinal set's copy of the page needs its own answers because its list and its start are its own.
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing germinal products on the 'What are you importing?' question and continuing, the germinal products 'Origin of the import' page shows a Back link that goes to that question. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-005; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028; conflicts:c-007)

Starting a notification from the germinal products set's own notifications list, the germinal products 'Origin of the import' page shows a Back link that goes to that list. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-005; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104)

Opening the origin task from a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Origin of the import' page shows a Back link that goes to that overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-028; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

Following the germinal products 'Origin of the import' page's Back link leaves the answers already saved against the notification as they were. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104)

notes: This area's part of inc-186 only. req-1740 already sits in inc-186 (theme germinal-products) alongside the templates area's req-1875 and req-1876: the combiner merges this draft back into inc-186 and keeps that id, its wider title and detail, its repos (backend joins from req-1875 and req-1876), its dependsOn (inc-182) and its externalDependsOn on the split-off type-question and type-question-and-templates workareas (inc-150, inc-151, inc-154 to inc-161, inc-164, inc-165).

Rewrite needed in inc-186: templates are no longer a Back destination (ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-010 dropped templates for now), so inc-186's title clause about returning to a template's review and its last acceptance criterion ('Opened while a saved germinal products template is being edited, the germinal products origin page's Back link goes to that template's review') are replaced by the three destinations above. req-1740's statement now names only the type question, the germinal set's own notifications list and the notification overview.

Ordering: the germinal set's origin page itself is built by inc-176 and the germinal set's root list by inc-141, so both must land before the Back link can be seen; inc-186's existing dependsOn inc-182 stays. The Back-to-the-type-question destination needs the type question, which the split-off type-question theme owns, and inc-186's externalDependsOn already names it.

Not split off: the code is the germinal products set's own origin feature folder and journey flow under frontend:src/server/app/sets/germinal-products, which the germinal-products theme owns. No split-off pointer touches it: origin-page and design-snagging touch only the live-animals and plants origin folders.
The shared return-marker and trail rule in the animals frontend is read, not changed, by this row: the split-off journey-foundation theme owns it.

splitOff.why: It changes the live-animals origin page's exits: the page gains a secondary 'Save and return to overview' button that saves before showing the overview and a 'Cancel and return to overview' link that reaches the overview even with no answers. That is frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/origin, its obligation section frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/origin.js and the page spec tests:tests/animals/e2e/pages/origin.spec.ts, all in theme origin-page's touches, and origin-page is the theme whose rows are the origin page's own behaviour. Its germinal half needs no row here: ruling:sam-2026-10-09 (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014) makes each germinal page a copy of its live-animals feature folder taken after the live twin is built, inc-176 copies the finished live-animals origin page into the germinal set, and inc-244 already covers both save buttons making the same checks on every germinal page that shows them. The blocker c-003 recorded (the 10 November ruling held the return links until the save and continue work merged) is gone: that work merged on 11 November, so req-051 carries no blockedBy and the row is buildable on the origin-page branch. The split-off design-snagging theme also lists the origin folder in its touches, but only to port finished origin-page work to main; origin-page is where the behaviour itself is built.
